banned_combo_check.note: Base is warm white #FFFDF8, not cream; headings are Baloo 2 / Cairo (sans); buttons are 12px rounded rectangles, not pills; hero is a full-width photo band, not a boxed card.

colour_strategy: Warm white #FFFDF8 base, deep rose #9C2B4A accent, sage green #4A6B57 secondary, muted brass #B08D3E for stars only; no orange UI accents anywhere
hero: Full-width photo band (plant-filled restaurant interior) with dark gradient overlay, oversized rounded headline over the photo, floating rating chip, and three rounded fact cards overlapping below
honesty_notes: No invented reviews, ratings, prices, awards, staff or numbers. Rating 4.4 / 5,055 reviews are verified (Evendo/Google). 'Why Taif chooses' is built from the five verified review themes, not invented quotes. 'Prices on request' appears once, in the menu section only. Gallery carries a note that photographs are illustrative food/interior photography, not Bohoo's own dishes. Footer disclaimer is the only 'Design concept' wording. No prices, no founded year, no staff names anywhere on the site.

images.format: WebP, 1600px + 800px srcset, every file under 250 KB

originality_note: Checked against design-log.json (55 entries): archetype 'Playful rounded' last used 2026-11-02 (Dilly Dally Coffee, outside the last 10) and differs from it on hero (full-width photo band vs split 50/50), fonts (Baloo 2 + Nunito Sans vs Fredoka + Nunito Sans), colour (warm white/rose/sage vs white/deep green/gold), signature (tabbed menu board + rose marquee + AR/EN toggle vs rounded pill chips + flag-order steps) and all image IDs. No image ID reused from the log (checked programmatically, 21 IDs, zero overlap). Combination differs from every log entry on at least 4 of 6 axes.
